materials_exhausted.note: Reopened primary XML, publisher/OA PDF text, OA package NXML/PDF/supplement PDF, supplement text index, packet database JSONL rows, and merged sequence/assay/literature outputs. The source supports all local activity values needed for the linked DBAASP rows; remaining cautions are adjudication cautions, not open rework.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay and experiment rows match source-reported trichormamide A/B IC50 values and article metadata; database-specific nonribosomal sequence encodings are preserved as source_conflict cautions because the primary source gives cyclic residue structures rather than those literal encoded strings.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML/PDF text supports four purified-compound IC50 rows and one fraction-level growth-inhibition context row; no local toxicity rows or replicate statistics were reported.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The paper supports only indirect lipopeptide amphiphilicity/membrane-interaction context from related compounds and reports no direct mechanism assay for trichormamides A/B.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_decision: The prior missing-activity and database-conflict blockers are repaired; no open targeted rework remains, so the paper is accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP encodings are retained from merged sequence rows and not silently normalized to the primary-paper cyclic residue strings.
Mechanism language is limited to indirect lipopeptide context; no direct mechanism assay is present in local XML/PDF/supplement material.
IC50 point values are source-supported, but local text does not report n/SD/SEM/CI for those rows.
The primary paper states limited supply of trichormamide A stopped statistically significant synergistic-assay data; no missing local table can repair this.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired worker-2 activity rows and worker-4 database reconciliation for trichormamides A/B. Worker-6 accepts the paper with cautions for database encoding provenance, missing replicate statistics, and absence of direct mechanism assays.
